description: Creates a vertical cover layout with an optional centered heading element.

examples.label: Example 1
examples.code:
A short introduction

A heading centered in the cover

Supporting information stays below.

attributes.name: gap
attributes.description: Gap between direct children. When absent, uses the --tp-cover-gap CSS default.

attributes.name: heading
attributes.description: Simple CSS selector (for example h2, .hero or #title) identifying a direct child to center vertically in the available space, not the heading text. Empty by default: no child is selected for centering.

attributes.name: min-height
attributes.description: Minimum block size of the cover. When absent, uses the --tp-cover-min-height CSS default.

attributes.name: padding
attributes.description: Padding applied inside the cover. When absent, uses the --tp-cover-padding CSS default.

dependencies.name: tp-base
dependencies.summary: Shared base class for tp-* components.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-cover>` element implements the <tp-icon name="cover" library="components" size="1.25em"></tp-icon> Cover functionality: creates a vertical cover layout with an optional centered heading element.
